abs.name: ABS / INEOS Terluran GP-22 reference
abs.yield_scope: Typical tensile yield at 23 C for injection-molded uncolored GP-22; not a guaranteed design allowable.
notes: Poisson ratio 0.35 is an explicit modeling assumption, not provided by the cited datasheet.
Typical injection-molding data; not validated for FDM or other additive processes.
Linear isotropic approximation does not represent creep, temperature, strain-rate or print anisotropy.
